# Monthly Operations Report - April 2026

CONFIDENTIAL - EXECUTIVE REVIEW ONLY
NOT FOR ALL-EMPLOYEE DISTRIBUTION

April operations remained on target across fulfillment, customer support, and field services.

- Customer satisfaction: 4.7/5
- Support backlog reduced by 12%
- No major service interruptions reported

Prepared for internal employee update distribution.
